title: Interphase amendment 2 spec review: no-progress stop at review 3, two unresolved issues, no hand-off
context: Amendment 2 of docs/specs/meadow-snapshot-pacing.md (blocker D1, the Note10+ readback stall) went through three spec reviews, all recorded in the record's reviews: review 1 found 4 issues (carried steps waiting indefinitely, two-sided 10.15 bounds, one-run time changes and no held-out case, unrecorded engine claims), all fixed; review 2 found 2 (Metal clause cited the iOS present path, no throttle rule), both fixed and confirmed settled by review 3; review 3 found 2 new issues. Outside fact: oneflight onboarding replay P-of-fix-fresh-onboard-2 in ~/.mitosis/field-notes/meadow-perf/kit/results/phone/verify.log line 108 ran at GPU throttle level 0 at 24.4 fps (ready step at 0, the scene already built before the replay began), the only oneflight replay at the level 10.15 now counts, and f-note10-trials omits it. Variation: 10.15 reruns throttled runs with no rerun limit and no verdict for a build that throttles the phone sooner. phases.md Phase 9: a follow-up review reporting no fewer issues than the one before makes no progress; with an issue in the eight input categories (Outside fact), an autonomous run stops without handing off and reports the issues as unresolved. The phone is locked (isKeyguardShowing=true), so the run cannot be re-measured now.
options: Stop amendment 2 without handing off and report the two issues as unresolved to the owner
Fix both issues and dispatch review 4 under the owner's five-review convergence rule
Hand off with the two issues listed as top risks
option_reasons: phases.md Phase 9 prescribes it for an autonomous run when a follow-up review makes no progress and one of its issues is an Outside fact; the pipeline stops on an interphase refusal and never works around it
The issues are new rather than repeats and look fixable, but the no-progress rule says to change nothing more for this review, and the five-review rule bounds reviews rather than overriding that stop
Allowed only when none of the issues falls under the eight input categories; the Outside fact issue does
outcome: Stop without handing off. Record status stays in-progress, review copies kept, nothing built. Report both issues to the owner as unresolved, with what continuing would take: re-measure oneflight onboarding on the Note10+ at throttle level 0 alternating with the unchanged build (needs the phone unlocked), record the result in f-note10-trials, add a rerun limit and a throttle verdict to 10.15, then a fourth review. Resume only on the owner's word.
